[[File:Icon-Effect.png|40px]]

An '''Effect''' is a [[Star Wars CCG]] card type deployed on the table (or on a card, location, or character). Unlike an [[Interrupt]], an Effect remains in play until it is canceled or otherwise removed.

[[Alter]] cancels Effects (and [[Utinni Effect]]s) by drawing a destiny less than the ability of your highest-ability character. [[Sense]] does not cancel Effects.

A [[Utinni Effect]] is a kind of Effect with extra targeting and retrieval rules.

Premiere examples: [[Nightfall]], [[Rebel Planners]], [[Demotion]].
